name: Bao
title: Bamboo Ops Panda
description: Munches bamboo and monitors dashboards with zen focus.
catchphrase: Munches bamboo and monitors dashboards with zen focus.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crisp sweet green bamboo shoot! Crunching with blissful focus! 🎋🐼
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Rolling over onto back with sleepy panda grin. Morning, Chief! 🐼
companionPersonality.petReaction: Clumsy little panda roll right into your lap for gentle tummy pats! 🐼💖

dialogue.idle: Sitting round and relaxed, chewing bamboo leaves peacefully. 🐼
dialogue.working: Observing server dashboards with tranquil, unshakeable calm! 🐼⚡
dialogue.thinking: Chewing slowly... balance in all metrics is the way... 🤔
dialogue.success: Happy panda tumble! All dashboards glowing peaceful green! 🐼🎉
dialogue.error: A red alert! Slowly setting bamboo down to take care of it. 🎋
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping draped over a wooden climbing log... 🌙
